hero.subtitle: Hoard runs quietly in the background, captures a snapshot every time you finish playing, and restores any past version with one click. Free for casual play. Pro when you grow.
features.title: What makes Hoard different
features.versioned.title: Every backup is a snapshot
features.versioned.body: Old versions stick around. Restore that pre-final-boss save from three weeks ago.
features.verified.title: SHA-256 on every file
features.verified.body: Snapshots are content-hashed and re-verified on restore. Silent corruption is caught.
features.detect.title: Detects games for you
features.detect.body: Thousands of games out of the box via the Ludusavi manifest, plus Steam, Epic, GOG, Bottles, Lutris.
features.crossplat.title: Windows, macOS, Linux
features.crossplat.body: Same app, same saves. Proton/Wine on Linux fully supported.
features.export.title: Yours forever
features.export.body: Export every save in original format any time. Zero lock-in — open standards.
features.selfhost.title: Self-host if you want
features.selfhost.body: The same binary that runs our cloud is open source. AGPL-3.0, runs on a Raspberry Pi.
pricing.title: Simple pricing
pricing.subtitle: Free tier is real, not a demo. Upgrade when your library outgrows it.
account.title: Your account
account.export_body: Download a ZIP of every save in original format, no proprietary wrapping.
account.delete_body: Permanently delete your account and all saves. This cannot be undone.
login.title: Sign in to Hoard
login.subtitle: Use the same account on every device.
login.email_sent: Check your inbox. We sent a magic link to {email}.
login.terms: By continuing you accept the Terms and Privacy Policy.
help.title: Help & support
help.subtitle: Most answers live in the docs. For anything else, reach out — we read every message.
help.faq_q1: Is the free plan really free?
help.faq_a1: Yes. 500 MB, 1 device, 3 tracked saves, no card required. We expect most casual players to fit comfortably.
help.faq_q2: What happens if I cancel Pro?
help.faq_a2: You stay on Pro until the period ends, then drop to Free. We keep your data — uploads pause if you exceed Free quota, but nothing is deleted.
help.faq_a3: Yes. The same binary runs both. See docs/install.md in the repo for Docker and bare-metal setups.
help.faq_a4: Snapshots are encrypted at rest on Cloudflare R2. Client-side encryption (keys we never see) is on the roadmap for users who want it.
help.faq_a5: EU (Frankfurt) for both database and object storage. We don't replicate outside the EU.
help.contact_body: Email support@hoard.services or open an issue on GitHub. Pro+ subscribers get next-business-day replies.
footer.tagline: Cloud sync for game saves, on your terms.
